sources.finding: Technical specification describes the theater stage and the scene shop loading connection, but supplies no scene-shop or classroom-studio perimeter. Stage width and depth do not define SCENE or STUDI.
Additional drafting is available through Production Drive by permission/request; no public room-labelled drafting was exposed on the index.
Confirms scene, paint and prop shops and work yard. Does not map schedule SCENE or STUDI to numbered rooms or floorplan polygons.
Links the systemwide UCOP performing-arts safety manual; no Mandell Weiss building-specific evacuation or room floorplan.
Distinguishes Mandell Weiss Theatre from Mandell Weiss Forum, Wagner Dance Building and Galbraith. Unrelated named dance studios or performance stages are not evidence for MWEIS STUDI.

decision: Retain both schedule rooms without geometry. No external message or access request was sent, no protected drawings were fetched, and no theater-stage outline was substituted for the scene shop or an unidentified studio.
